At right foreground show a calm fictional adult Congolese woman clinician, shoulders to waist, looking gently toward camera, simple unbranded cream medical coat, natural expression, hands relaxed. Clear readable warm face in right third, not cropped out. Left 48 percent is naturally dark teal foliage and dusk shade with simple low-detail negative space for live HTML text overlay. Clinic in right middle ground. Light from a small doorway only, no bright artificial spotlight. No patients. This is an illustrative game scene, not documentary evidence of a real clinic. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO signs, NO symbols, NO logos, NO interface, NO buttons, NO cards, NO typography, NO watermark, NO red cross, NO border. Subtle texture and beautiful lighting, restrained, human and hopeful, nothing theatrical or distressing.
